text:
Jonas: Saw something off with CredoTherm's March invoice (INV-2026-0423) — they were billed twice for a large usage spike (~$24,000). Can finance take a look?
Maya (Finance): Ugh, I see it. Looks like ingestion duplicated session IDs during the ETL window. We'll need to either void+reissue or apply a manual adjustment. What does sales want for customer retention?
Eli (AcctOps): If they're on Reserved we should reissue corrected invoice and post a service credit. Keeps AR tidy.
Jonas: They're on a reserved monthly commit and flagged churn risk. They specifically asked for a one-time waiver to avoid escalation.
Maya (Finance): Ok. Proposal: manual credit of $24,000 to INV-2026-0423, reissue corrected invoice, tag memo 'metering-duplication' and link ticket #2389. Note: any >$20k credit needs legal approval — @Anya, can you sign off?
Anya (Legal): Approved for a one-time goodwill credit given platform error. Please add 'no admission of liability' language in the reissued invoice and record in the vendor correction log.
billing-bot: Adjustment created: ADJ-78321 for $24,000 (status: pending finance finalize).
Eli (AcctOps): I'll stage ledger entry: `ledger adjust --account CredoTherm --adj ADJ-78321 --amount -24000 --memo "Duplicate metering March 2026 - ticket #2389"`
Maya (Finance): Thanks, Eli. I'll finalize the adjustment and request reissue. @Jonas please confirm the customer accepts a reissue + account credit.
Jonas: Pinged them now.
Jonas: (10m later) They confirmed — prefer reissue + credit. Said "appreciate the fast fix". :thumbsup:
Maya (Finance): Great. Adjustment will post EOD and reissued invoice will be sent tomorrow. I'll add the audit trail and close ticket #2389 once done.
Jonas: Thanks everyone — closing the loop.
